description: This file defines a mock class 'ServerMock' for the 'IServer' interface used in IPC testing within the Rialto project. It includes mock methods for socket management, client addition, and server control functions, utilizing Google Mock framework.

classes.name: ServerMock
classes.description: A mock implementation of the IServer interface for unit testing IPC server behavior.

methods.name: addSocket
methods.description: Mocks adding a socket with specified path and connection callbacks.

methods.name: addClient
methods.description: Mocks adding a client with a socket file descriptor and disconnection callback.

methods.name: fd
methods.description: Mocks retrieving the server's file descriptor.

methods.name: wait
methods.description: Mocks waiting with a specified timeout.
